loginMethods.title: Google Sign in
loginMethods.statusMessage: Please note: On 31 March 2023, "Sign-In with Google" will be discontinued by Google. Beginning 30 April 2023, please use the other 2 methods to login.
loginMethods.domainNote: Linked @351silverstar.com, @gapps.yrdsb.ca, @ycdsb.ca domains only. Remember to sign off from both the website and from Google when completed.

loginMethods.title: Cadet 365 Sign in
